:::{#cor-var-mse-bias}
#### Standard error squared equals MSE minus squared bias

The squared standard error is what remains of the mean squared error
after the squared bias is removed:

$$\sqf{\SE{\hth}} = \mselr{\hth} - \sqf{\bias{\hth}}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-var-mse-bias.

:::
